_amzl_comment: AMZL (Delivery Station) sources. AMZL uses ONLY Process Inspector (PPA) + Roster. process_id is PER-SITE in delivery (some DS use 100541 'ADTA Stow', others 100021 'Stow'). amzl_process_by_site overrides amzl_default_process for a given DS code.
_amzl_common_processes_comment: Processes pulled for EVERY delivery station in addition to its per-site process. Pick & Stage (100407) is common to all DS.
_amzl_process_by_site_comment: PPA process_id per DS. 100021=Stow, 100541=ADTA Stow. To be managed from the admin panel later; hardcoded here for now. Test sites: DMZ2=stow, DMA4=adta.
_amzl_lc_url_comment: LC (Learning Curve) source for Delivery Stations, on the SHARED 'Project Argos/DS LC' drive.corp folder (team-owned, not a personal account). Argos downloads this export each pipeline run and caches it as amzl_lc_cache.csv; amzl_lc.py reads that cache. CSV (header on row 1) and legacy xlsx (banner + header on row 3) are both accepted. Columns include DS, Process, Login, LC, LC Hours. Without it every AA defaults to LC1.
_amzl_curve_proc_comment: Maps PPA process_id -> Learning Curve process key in amzl_curves.json (so the rate's process picks the right curve). 100021=Stow, 100541=ADTA Stow, 100407=Pick & Stage (P&S).
_amzl_process_display_comment: Display name shown in the dashboard Role column per PPA process_id. Distinguishes ADTA Stow from normal Stow and labels Pick & Stage.
_amzl_process_windows_comment: Per-SITE, per-PROCESS time windows (local HH:MM). Normally EMPTY: delivery measures every process over the SELECTED CYCLE's range (see shift_config.json DMA4 Cycle_1/Cycle_2). Only set this to override a single process to a different window than the cycle.
_amzl_no_min_hours_comment: PPA process_ids EXEMPT from the 1-hour minimum-hours active filter (short-duration processes where <1h is still valid productivity). Pick & Stage runs in a short cycle.
_amzl_all_processes_comment: ALL PPA process_ids pulled for EVERY delivery station (each DS runs both stow-types + Pick & Stage). When set, supersedes amzl_process_by_site/amzl_default_process. 100021=Stow, 100541=ADTA Stow, 100407=Pick & Stage.
_amzl_min_hours_threshold_comment: Minimum paid hours to count an associate as active in AMZL only (delivery cycles are short). Independent from the FC min_hours_threshold (1.0).
_min_hours_by_site_comment: Per-site override of the FC min_hours_threshold (1.0). Ad-hoc request: MAD7 GM wants 0.5h minimum in role to appear. Sites not listed use min_hours_threshold.
